name: 项目经费大屏
description: 项目经费执行驾驶舱：经费结构分布、直接成本执行率、总经费执行率和项目明细。

sqlConfig.query:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT project_id, cycle,
    total_fund::NUMERIC AS total_fund,
    direct_ctrl::NUMERIC AS direct_ctrl,
    reserve_indirect::NUMERIC AS reserve_indirect,
    direct_rate::NUMERIC AS direct_rate,
    indirect_spent::NUMERIC AS indirect_spent,
    ROUND(direct_ctrl::NUMERIC * direct_rate::NUMERIC / 100, 2) AS direct_spent,
    ROUND(direct_ctrl::NUMERIC * direct_rate::NUMERIC / 100, 2) + indirect_spent::NUMERIC AS total_spent,
    ROUND((ROUND(direct_ctrl::NUMERIC * direct_rate::NUMERIC / 100, 2) + indirect_spent::NUMERIC) * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_fund::NUMERIC, 0), 1) AS total_rate
  FROM ods_finance_project_fund
)
SELECT
  SUM(total_fund) AS sum_total_fund
FROM base

config.title: 项目经费明细表
header: 预留间接费用和收益(万)
间接费用支出和收益总额(万)

sqlConfig.query:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT project_id, cycle,
    total_fund::NUMERIC AS total_fund,
    direct_ctrl::NUMERIC AS direct_ctrl,
    reserve_indirect::NUMERIC AS reserve_indirect,
    direct_rate::NUMERIC AS direct_rate,
    indirect_spent::NUMERIC AS indirect_spent,
    ROUND(direct_ctrl::NUMERIC * direct_rate::NUMERIC / 100, 2) AS direct_spent,
    ROUND(direct_ctrl::NUMERIC * direct_rate::NUMERIC / 100, 2) + indirect_spent::NUMERIC AS total_spent,
    ROUND((ROUND(direct_ctrl::NUMERIC * direct_rate::NUMERIC / 100, 2) + indirect_spent::NUMERIC) * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_fund::NUMERIC, 0), 1) AS total_rate
  FROM ods_finance_project_fund
)
SELECT
  project_id AS "项目编号",
  cycle AS "研制周期",
  total_fund AS "总经费(万)",
  direct_ctrl AS "直接成本控制数(万)",
  reserve_indirect AS "预留间接费用和收益(万)",
  direct_rate AS "直接成本执行率(%)",
  indirect_spent AS "间接费用支出和收益总额(万)",
  total_spent AS "总支出(万)",
  total_rate AS "总执行率(%)"
FROM base
ORDER BY project_id
